market_view.rationale: Heavy institutional support remains intact with FII net buying exceeding ₹11,900 crore across three sessions while INDIA VIX cooled slightly to 16.55. Although Nifty 50 experienced a -1.07% single-day pullback, positive mid- and small-cap performance demonstrates healthy underlying rotation rather than broad distribution.

sector_pick.name: NIFTY REALTY
sector_pick.rationale: Nifty Realty commands top relative strength with a 20.19% one-month return and strong positive momentum delta, making it the prime target for momentum swing trading.

last_week_review: Last week's bullish lean held up well as sustained FII liquidity supported overall market structure, though frontline indices consolidated late in the week while broader market breadth stabilized.
